CASE WHEN vfpoh.lgcy_ord_fr_supl_id = '*' THEN NULL ELSE vfpoh.lgcy_ord_fr_supl_id END
CASE WHEN vfpol.cfm_ctrl_cd > '' AND (SUBSTR(vfpol.purch_doc_nbr,1,3)='430' OR SUBSTR(vfpol.purch_doc_nbr,1,3)='700') THEN 'WINGS' ELSE vfpol.purch_doc_rqstr_uid END

CASE WHEN vfsiel.dr_cr_ind='S' THEN (CASE WHEN fin_doc_rvrs_nbr<>'*' THEN 'Reversed Debit' ELSE 'Debit' END) ELSE (CASE WHEN fin_doc_rvrs_nbr<>'*' THEN 'Reversed Credit' ELSE 'Credit' END) END

CASE WHEN fin_doc_rvrs_ind = 'Y' THEN 'Reversed' ELSE (CASE WHEN pmt_bloc_ind = 'Y' THEN 'Blocked' ELSE (CASE WHEN clr_doc_nbr = '*' THEN 'Pending' ELSE 'Cleared' END) END) END

CASE WHEN vsca.src_sys_nm = 'SBI-NBP' THEN CASE vsca.aprv_sts_cd WHEN 'I1129' THEN 'Approved' WHEN 'I1015' THEN 'Awaiting Approval' WHEN 'I1016' THEN 'Rejected' ELSE 'Review' END ELSE CASE vsca.aprv_sts_cd WHEN '3' THEN 'Approved' WHEN '1' THEN 'Waiting' WHEN '2' THEN 'Rejected' ELSE 'Review' END END
